title: The letters in the essence of the soul: how one level becomes another
overview:
The chapter explains the garments of thought, speech and action from their root: the letters. The soul is full of letters from the moment it comes into being, letters of thought and letters of speech, each on three levels, from a bare picture or voice, which an animal also has, up to analysis and ordered speech. Speech is really the higher of the two: we are called talking man.

Even before the simple will there are letters, and above, in the Essence, they come before the light itself. They are not the power to limit: they are the power to define anything, finite or infinite, what makes a thing a something. After the will comes into being they become its letters, and only through letters can one *mahus* pass into another: the will into its reason, into the love in the will, the intellect into emotion, the emotion into thought (the man nervous before a job interview), thought into speech. So there is a chain from the essence of the soul to the end of action, and above, from the Essence down to the snow outside; and the higher levels are more of a something, not less.

terms.gloss: letters; the powers in the soul, and above in the Essence, to define anything as a something
vessels; the letters, whose root is higher than the light itself
the simple matter of every letter: the voice before the letters are cut, the highest level up there
the breath of the spirit of speech: the wind pushed out when one wants to talk
the cutting of the letters: each letter by itself, the second level of speech
the power to limit; it too comes from the letters, which are not it
the power of the unlimited; a definition made by G-d, not G-d Himself
the true something, the absolute something; why G-d has letters
a movement; letters are the various movements of what one can do
passing thoughts; the thoughts that come up out of an emotion

sections.title: The soul is full of letters: thought and speech, each on three levels
sections.summary: The root of the letters is the essence of the soul, which has letters of thought and letters of speech from the moment it comes into being, each breaking out on three levels, from a picture or a bare voice up to analysis and ordered speech. Speech is really the higher of the two: man is the talking one.

phrases.he: (לח) והנה מעתה יש להבין דרך פרט יותר בענין הלבושין דמחשבה דבור ומעשה כו',
כמו שכתוב לבושין תקינת לון כו'
ולזה יש להקדים תחלה שרש ומקור לבחינת האותיות, ומה שלפעמים נקראו בשם כלים ולפעמים בשם לבושין כו'
ואחר כך יתבאר דרך פרט בבחינת רחל ולאה, ומלכות דתבונה ובינה, עד רום המעלות כו'
דהנה שרש אותיות הוא בעצם הנפש ממש, שהנפש מלאה אותיות כידוע,
והיינו מתחלת עצם התהוותה

blocks.text: Now the chapter explains in particular the *levushim* (garments) of thought, speech and action. First it gives the root and source of the *osios* (letters), and why they are sometimes called *kelim* (vessels) and sometimes *levushim*; after that, Rachel and Leah, up to the highest levels. The root of the letters is in the essence of the soul *mamash*: the soul is full of letters from the very start of its coming into being. The letters are higher than anything.

phrases.he: ובב' אופנים, באותיות המחשבה ואותיות הדבור
phrases.en: There is already in the soul *osios hamachshava* and *osios hadibur*.

phrases.he: דהיינו מיד שתתהווה עצם הנפש מיוחדים בה אותיות מחשבה
וכלולים בה בעצם, כמו שכלול תנועת החי בחי כו'
ויוצאים ובוקעים לגלוי מחשבה בג' מדריגות
דמיון וציור בלא אותיות כלל,
phrases.en: imagination of a picture without actual letters of speech

phrases.he: ואותיות פשוטים מבולבלים בלי צירוף וחיבור ענין דבר מה,
phrases.en: just letters of blabbering that are all mixed up

phrases.he: ואותיות מצורפים על פי מחשבה עיונית כו'
phrases.en: *osios* are made up into thought through the *machshava iyunis*, through an analysis of a subject

blocks.text: The letters are in the soul in two ways: **there is already in the soul *osios hamachshava* and *osios hadibur*** (letters of thought and letters of speech). As soon as the soul comes into being, the letters of thought are united with it, included in its essence as movement is in a living thing, and they break out into thought on three levels. The first is **imagination of a picture without actual letters of speech**, and this an animal has too. The second is **just letters of blabbering that are all mixed up**. The third is letters put together by *machshava iyunis* (analytical thought), **through an analysis of a subject**.

phrases.he: וכך יש בעצם הנפש בחינת אותיות הדבור
phrases.en: the same thing, there's in *etzem hanefesh* also *osios hadibur*

phrases.he: שהרי נקראת נפש המדברת או רוח ממללא
phrases.en: we're called talking man

phrases.he: וכלולים בה בעצם, ויוצאים לגלוי כתנועת החי וכהאי גוונא
כדבור של המלאכים דכתיב וקרא זה אל זה כו'

blocks.text: Speech letters are in the essence of the soul too: **the same thing, there's in *etzem hanefesh* also *osios hadibur***, for the soul is called the speaking soul. **We're called talking man**, not *Homo sapiens*, which means thinking man: according to *Chassidus* and Kabbala, man is the one who talks. These letters too are included in the soul's essence and come out into the open like the movement of a living thing, like the speech of the angels, of whom it says "and one called to the other".

phrases.he: והוא גם כן בג' מדריגות:
phrases.en: *osios hadibur* is also in three levels

phrases.he: חומר פשוט של כל אות ואות, ונקרא הבל רוח הדבור
ואותיות א''ב ג''ד מיוחדים בלי צירוף
phrases.en: the actual *chitoch* or the letter itself, but not the combination of the letters

phrases.he: וחיבור האותיות,
phrases.en: then the *osios* in order in the speech

phrases.he: שנקרא צורה שבדבור ברוח ממללא
כמו ב' רוחות מספרות, וכדבור המלאכים וכו':

blocks.text: ***Osios hadibur* is also in three levels.** The first is the *chomer pashut* (the simple matter) of every letter, called the *hevel ruach hadibur* (the breath of the spirit of speech). It is the actual sound, before it has letters in it, just as the imagination is before it has letters. Already in the sound there is a *midda* (an emotion).

blocks.title: The dog's voice
blocks.text: This level of speech, like the imagination on the first level of thought, an animal also has. You can hear from a dog's voice whether he is happy or sad: he has the *hevel ruach hadibur*.

The second level is the *chitoch* (cutting) of the letters, *alef*, *beis*, *gimmel*, *dalet*, each by itself: **the actual *chitoch* or the letter itself, but not the combination of the letters**. The third is the joining of the letters, **then the *osios* in order in the speech**, called the form of speech: like two spirits talking to each other, like the speech of the angels.

blocks.question: So these letters are already in the soul. But why two different kinds? Aren't the letters of speech just the letters of thought being revealed?
blocks.text: Speech letters come from his wanting to talk, and wanting to think and wanting to talk are two different things. Speech has to come through thought; you cannot talk without thinking. But look closer and it is the other way around: you cannot think without talking. The letters of speech are higher, which is why we are called talking man.

That is one of the whole reasons that Torah study has to be *davka* (specifically) by talking and not only by thinking: talking activates thinking. Speech has to come through thought, but speech is the higher of the two. And you see that when somebody cannot talk in letters, he cannot think in letters either.

sensitivity.reason: "When somebody can't talk in letters, he can't think in letters either" could be read as a claim about people who cannot speak.

blocks.text: That is why, in a way, the highest thing is *davka* what little children do when they first start school, the *tinokos shel beis rabban*, saying *alef*, *beis*, *gimmel*, *dalet*. A listener offers that the first thing a baby does is what the text says here, the letters all jumbled up: baby talk. Yes, but there is something even before that.
blocks.outOfPlace: Later in class 208 (w1844-2312), between his first reading of lines 18-19 and his rereading of them, he comes back to the three levels of speech in lines 14-15.

blocks.text: Before the jumbled letters there is just a voice. That is the whole thing of the shofar: a shofar is just a voice, the first level, which even an animal has. And upstairs is backwards: what is lowest down here is highest up there. So the plain voice, before even the *chitoch* of the letters, is the highest level up there, where there are not really even letters, only the *chomer pashut* that all the letters can come out of.
blocks.outOfPlace: Later in class 208 (w1844-2312), between his first reading of lines 18-19 and his rereading of them, he comes back to the three levels of speech in lines 14-15.

blocks.question: Then why does the text say the chomer pashut "of every single letter"?
blocks.text: It is not just a simple voice: in the simple voice is the *chomer pashut* of every single letter. In any letter that you say there is a *chomer pashut*, the voice in it.
blocks.outOfPlace: Later in class 208 (w1844-2312), between his first reading of lines 18-19 and his rereading of them, he comes back to the three levels of speech in lines 14-15.

blocks.question: But isn't the voice really the vowels, which are not the letter itself?
blocks.text: No, the vowels too are made of a voice. The simple voice, the *hevel*, is the basic voice of the letter: not just a sound, but someone voicing a letter because he wants to say something, as the shofar is a plain sound and yet a sound of supplication. The *chitoch*, *alef*, *beis*, *gimmel*, *dalet*, where it is already a letter, is the second level. The first is the *hevel ruach hadibur*, the wind: not of breathing, but when you want to talk and push out a letter.
blocks.outOfPlace: Later in class 208 (w1844-2312), between his first reading of lines 18-19 and his rereading of them, he comes back to the three levels of speech in lines 14-15.

sections.title: Letters before the will: the power to define anything
sections.summary: Even before the simple will there are letters in the essence of the soul, and above, in the Essence: not the power to limit, but the power to define anything, finite or infinite, which makes a thing what it is. After the will comes into being they become the will's own letters, its somethingness.

phrases.he: והנה גם טרם שמתהוה מקור לרצון פשוט ותענוג פשוט, כבר יש אותיות הכלולים בעצם הנפש
רק אחר התהוות הרצון יוצאים
phrases.en: then these letters go out and become lower letters

phrases.he: להיות בחינת גלוי לרצון,
phrases.en: then they become the *kelim* of the *ratzon*, and they reveal the *ratzon*

phrases.he: ונקראו אותיות דרצון
phrases.en: then they're not the *osios* of the *Atzmus* anymore, they're the *osios* of the *ratzon*

blocks.text: Even before there comes into being a source for the simple will and the simple delight, which means even before *Keser* (crown) of *Ein Sof* (the Infinite), there are letters included in the essence of the soul, higher than the *sefiros* (the Divine attributes) themselves. Only after the will comes into being do they become a revelation of the will, called the letters of the will. But really the will itself has to be made of letters in the first place, which say that this is a will and not something else. Before the will there are letters too, and the will comes into being *davka* from the letters.
blocks.outOfPlace: He first reads lines 18-19 here (208 w653-741), in the middle of his talk on the letters; the alignment marks only his rereading at w2315.

blocks.text: The letters are the powers in the soul to define things. Above, this power is in the essence of the *Ein Sof* and comes before the light: the letters, the *kelim*, have a higher root than the light. Even the *Or Ein Sof* (the infinite light) came from a "Let there be light" made of letters, as further down the ten utterances come from *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Atzilus*.
blocks.outOfPlace: He first reads lines 18-19 here (208 w653-741), in the middle of his talk on the letters; the alignment marks only his rereading at w2315.

blocks.text: Even the original infinite light came into being because the *Aibershter* (G-d) said that He wanted it, and even the first will, the *ratzon hapashut* (simple will), came from His deciding that there should be a will. Otherwise there would be none: it doesn't have to be a will, and it doesn't have to be a delight. As far as the *Aibershter* Himself is concerned, there is just the *Aibershter*, not even a *ratzon hapashut*.
blocks.outOfPlace: He first reads lines 18-19 here (208 w653-741), in the middle of his talk on the letters; the alignment marks only his rereading at w2315.

blocks.question: So what is there? How does He think?
blocks.text: He doesn't have to think; He is not like us. What the *Atzmus* (Essence) really is we do not know, but He does have letters. Letters means He can define anything He wants to define. Even the *ratzon hapashut* is already a definition: simple, and not existing at all relative to what is below it, but relative to the *Aibershter* it is already a matter of letters.
blocks.outOfPlace: He first reads lines 18-19 here (208 w653-741), in the middle of his talk on the letters; the alignment marks only his rereading at w2315.

blocks.question: So these letters are the koach hagvul, the power to limit?
blocks.text: Not necessarily. Both the *koach hagvul* (the power to limit) and the *koach habli gvul* (the power of the unlimited), which the *Or Ein Sof* is, come from the letters. Neither defines the *Aibershter*; both are definitions made by Him through the letters, which is why each is a *koach* (power). Some people think the *koach habli gvul* is the *Aibershter*. It is not: it too is a definition, of the unlimited.
blocks.outOfPlace: He first reads lines 18-19 here (208 w653-741), in the middle of his talk on the letters; the alignment marks only his rereading at w2315.

blocks.title: Rich and poor
blocks.text: So you say: unlimited means without a limit, so how is it a definition? It is *davka* unlimited and not limited, as rich means not poor. You could say rich includes poor, since a rich man also has $10. Yes, but he does not have the limitation of $10: if he wants, he can go past it, and a poor man cannot. So too infinite means not finite. And if you say the finite must be included in the infinite or the infinite is missing something, that is not like me: I am finite and stuck with it. Infinite means that if He wants, He can be finite, as the rich man can spend only $10. It doesn't work the other way. I can say, "If I want, I can fly." No, I can't.
blocks.outOfPlace: He first reads lines 18-19 here (208 w653-741), in the middle of his talk on the letters; the alignment marks only his rereading at w2315.

blocks.text: So the letters cannot be called the *koach hagvul*, which refers only to the finite. They can define a thing as finite or as infinite. And it is not just a power to define: it is what makes a thing what it is, His power to say or do anything that He wants.
blocks.outOfPlace: He first reads lines 18-19 here (208 w653-741), in the middle of his talk on the letters; the alignment marks only his rereading at w2315.

blocks.text: That is thought, speech and action: how does He do anything He wants? It is all the letters. Letters means the various *tnuos* (movements) of what He can do, and He can do anything; if He wants, He also has a *tnua* of no *tnua*, and does nothing at all. These letters are not actual letters. The whole thing is a total *hiyuli* (raw potential). In us it already sort of is like a letter, and not really infinite.
blocks.outOfPlace: He first reads lines 18-19 here (208 w653-741), in the middle of his talk on the letters; the alignment marks only his rereading at w2315.

blocks.text: When a person is sleeping, all the letters are there. Everything that comes out, what you see, hear, say, think and do, comes in letters that were already there. Even the emotions come in letters, which say that this is this emotion, and even the raw emotions have to come in letters: that is the *chomer pashut*. It is almost as if you would say that this is what the *Aibershter* is: letters.
blocks.outOfPlace: He first reads lines 18-19 here (208 w653-741), in the middle of his talk on the letters; the alignment marks only his rereading at w2315.

blocks.text: Now he reads the lines again. Even before the simple will, letters are fixed in the essence of the soul. Only after the will comes into being **these letters go out and become lower letters**: **they become the *kelim* of the *ratzon*, and they reveal the *ratzon***. Then **they're not the *osios* of the *Atzmus* anymore, they're the *osios* of the *ratzon***.

phrases.he: שהוא בחינת גלוי הרצון ליש ודבר מה במציאת רצון,
שזהו עיקר ענין האותיות בעצם הנפש
שאינו רק בחינת גלוי אור עצם הנפש בכל איזה בחינת יש ומציאת דבר מה
phrases.en: any kind of revelation or something in a way of a *yesh* or an existence of something

phrases.he: על ידי האותיות
phrases.en: that will come later through the *osios*

phrases.he: יוצא בגלוי מבחינת היולי הנעלם כו'
(וכמו שכתוב בלקוטי אמרים בכ''ב אותיות שקבועים בנפש, שהן כ''ב כחות,
כ''ב תנועות הנפש כו')
phrases.en: It's 22 movements of the soul.

blocks.text: This is the main thing of the letters in the essence of the soul: a revelation of the light of the soul's essence as a *yesh*, a something. That is what letters are: **any kind of revelation or something in a way of a *yesh* or an existence of something**. Through the letters it comes out from the hidden *hiyuli* of the letters in the essence of the soul. The letters are the somethingness of a thing; that the soul has letters is its somethingness.

And why does the *Aibershter* have letters too? Because He is the *yesh ha'amiti* (the true something). So He can make any kind of something that He wants, and that is what a letter is: what you make somethings with.

blocks.title: Carving a toy
blocks.text: Take a knife and carve a piece of wood into a little toy: that is done with letters. There are the various *tnuos* of the knife, and the letters of the form, the picture in the imagination that was mentioned before. Anything has to be done with letters.
As *Likkutei Amarim* explains, the twenty-two letters fixed in the soul are twenty-two powers: **it's 22 movements of the soul**.

sections.title: Through letters the will passes from mahus to mahus
sections.summary: Without letters, which say what a thing is, its *mahus* (being), and that it is, its *metzius* (existence), the hidden will could never take on another garment: it is the will's letters that carry it into the reason for the will, and from there into the love in the will, down to the will for an action. All this is still within the will, in *Arich*.

phrases.he: ועל ידי זה יוכל הרצון לבא בגלוי באור השכל
ולולי התגלות הרצון בבחינת אותיות,
דהיינו מה שנראה למהות ומציאת רצון,
phrases.en: so that you know what this *ratzon* is, and what its *metzius* is

phrases.he: לא היה בא הרצון העצמי הנעלם בלבוש אחר ממהות למהות
phrases.en: It would not be able to come into a different *levush* and go from one *mahus* to another *mahus*.

phrases.he: שהוא בחינת הרצון הנראה ונגלה בשכל וטעם לרצון כידוע,
phrases.en: the rational of the *ratzon*

phrases.he: ודי למבין

blocks.text: The will needs letters before it, to make it a will, and its own letters after it, or it could not be revealed in the intellect. Without them, **so that you know what this *ratzon* is, and what its *metzius* is**, the hidden will **would not be able to come into a different *levush* and go from one *mahus* to another *mahus***: from will to intellect.

That is the will as it is seen and revealed in the reason for the will: the *chachma stima'a* (hidden wisdom) of *Arich*, **the rational of the *ratzon***. It is not talking about actual intellect yet, only the intellect of the will.

phrases.he: וכך בשכל וטעם לרצון, שנקרא חכמה שברצון
מה שנראה למציאת טעם לרצון
הוא בחינת אותיות שבו
phrases.en: That's also *osios*.

phrases.he: על ידי זה יורד ממהות למהות המדות שברצון
phrases.en: It goes from this *mahus* of the *sechel* of the *ratzon* to this *mahus* of the *middos shebaratzon*.

phrases.he: כמו האהבה שברצון, שגם הוא אינו רק מציאת רצון,
phrases.en: it's also a *ratzon*

phrases.he: אלא שמלובש במהות אהבה,
phrases.en: it's enclosed in a *mahus* of love

phrases.he: שמצד הרצון הוא אוהב
phrases.en: because he wants this thing, he loves it

phrases.he: (אהבה לשון אבה, והה''א ה' חסדים המתפשטים מחכמה ובינה כו')

blocks.text: So too the reason for the will, called the *chachma* of the will: what is seen as the existence of a reason for the will. **That's also *osios*.** Through them **it goes from this *mahus* of the *sechel* of the *ratzon* to this *mahus* of the *middos shebaratzon*** (the emotions in the will). Take the love in the will: **it's also a *ratzon***, but **it's enclosed in a *mahus* of love**: **because he wants this thing, he loves it**.

*Ahava* (love) comes from *ava* (to want), and the letter *heh* is the five *chasadim* that spread out from *chachma* and *bina*. There is the original will, and *chachma* and *bina* spread it out into an emotion of love.

phrases.he: ואותו הרצון עצמו הוא בשכל וטעם לרצון,
phrases.en: this same *ratzon* itself, which is higher than *sechel v'taam l'ratzon*, it is also still in the *sechel v'taam l'ratzon*

phrases.he: והוא עצם הרצון בהיותו עדיין למעלה מהשכל וטעם כו'
ואמנם על פי האותיות נשתנה ונראה בלמעלה מן השכל ובשכל ובמדות כו'
phrases.en: Through the *osios* it can change over from higher than *sechel* to *sechel* and to lower than *sechel*, into *middos*.

phrases.he: וכן יש אותיות למדות,
phrases.en: the same thing, the *middos* also have letters

phrases.he: שהוא מה שנראה האהבה שברצון במציאת יש כו'
עד הרצון שבמחשבה דבור ומעשה,
phrases.en: in other words, *Malchus* of the *ratzon*

phrases.he: לכולם יש בחינת אותיות,
עד אותיות הרצון שבמעשה
phrases.en: not the actual *maaseh*, the *ratzon* for the *maaseh*, which is the end of *Malchus* of *Arich*

phrases.he: כשהמעשה עולה ברצונו,
phrases.en: when the *maaseh* comes up in his *ratzon* that he wants to do such and such a thing

phrases.he: שיש לזה אותיות מיוחדים
phrases.en: It has special kind of letters.

blocks.text: **This same *ratzon* itself, which is higher than *sechel v'taam l'ratzon*** (the reason for the will), **is also still in the *sechel v'taam l'ratzon***. It is enclosed in the reason, as the will is enclosed in everything, in the love and in the emotions too. Yet **through the *osios* it can change over from higher than *sechel* to *sechel* and to lower than *sechel*, into *middos***.

In **the same thing, the *middos* also have letters**: what is seen of the love in the will as an existing something. And all this is still in the will. We have not even got to actual intellect or emotions yet; we are not even in *Atzilus* yet. The whole thing is in *Arich*.

So on down to the will in thought, speech and action, **in other words, *Malchus* of the *ratzon***: all of them have letters, down to the letters of the will for action, *maaseh*. That is **not the actual *maaseh*, the *ratzon* for the *maaseh*, which is the end of *Malchus* of *Arich***: **when the *maaseh* comes up in his *ratzon* that he wants to do such and such a thing**, and **it has special kind of letters**. They are all letters of the will, but within them there are different kinds.

sections.title: Intellect into emotion, emotion into thought: the man waiting for a job interview
sections.summary: Below the will it is the same: the intellect becomes an emotion, a *hispaalus* (arousal), the emotion becomes thought and thought becomes speech only because each has letters of its own. The man nervous before a job interview shows it in both directions.

phrases.he: וכן על דרך זה בשכל שאחר הרצון
שאם לא היה השכל במציאת אותיות השכל, שהוא בחינת גלוי השכל במציאת, איך היה השכל בא בשינוי המהות בהתפעלות האהבה הנולד מצד השכל
phrases.en: If the *sechel* would not come into letters of its *metzius*, what it is, then how could there be *hispaalus* to actual *middos* to come from the *sechel*?

phrases.he: שגם שם הוא אותו השכל שהיה טרם שהוליד האהבה רק שנתלבש במהות אהבה כו'
אין זה רק על ידי האותיות שבו
phrases.en: That's only through the *osios*.

blocks.text: So too with the intellect after the will. **If the *sechel* would not come into letters of its *metzius*, what it is, then how could there be *hispaalus* to actual *middos* to come from the *sechel*?** In the love it is the same intellect, only dressed in the *mahus* of love: *chesed* of *chesed* of the intellect. **That's only through the *osios*.**

phrases.he: וכן על דרך זה אותיות דמדות במחשבה
phrases.en: the letters of *middos* that come in *machshava*

phrases.he: אם לא היה המדה במציאת יש באותיות,
איך מתלבשת במהות מחשבה וכו',
phrases.en: How could it become enclothed in a thought about it?

phrases.he: וכן אותיות המחשבה בדבור כו'
phrases.en: the letters of thought when they get enclothed into letters of speech

blocks.text: The same with **the letters of *middos* that come in *machshava***, as in the last chapter. If the emotion did not exist as something in letters, **how could it become enclothed in a thought about it?**

blocks.title: Nervous before a job interview
blocks.text: A man sits waiting for a job interview: "Oh man, I'm really nervous." Nervousness is a *midda*. If the *midda* could not come into letters, how could he think, "I'm really nervous"? And without letters there would have been no *midda* in the first place: he is nervous because he is thinking about the job interview.

blocks.title: Nervous before a job interview
blocks.text: The emotion came out of the intellect, which had to have letters telling him his analysis. He knows what kind of employer this is, what kind of job, what it pays, how much he wants it and how he can get his wife the swimming pool if he gets it; he knows his training, and that other guys with good training want this job too. The *chachma* looks over the whole thing, the *bina* analyzes it all, and it goes into *Malchus* of *tevuna*. From there comes a thought, and from that thought the original *midda*. Then, as he sits there, the nervousness goes up into the *hirhurei liba* (the thoughts of the heart) in his thought.

blocks.title: Nervous before a job interview
blocks.text: Now the text is saying that out of this *midda* come thoughts, the *hirhurim*. Not "So you're nervous, fine, forget about it": while he sits there he is thinking, "I wonder what they're going to ask me." All these letters come out of the *midda*. If it had no letters, how could he be thinking whatever he is thinking while he sits there? And so on with **the letters of thought when they get enclothed into letters of speech**.

sections.title: From the essence of the soul to the end of action, and the nimshal above
sections.summary: Through the letters there is a chain from the essence of the soul to the end of action, and above, from the letters in the Essence to this world, which is why the higher levels are more of a something, not less. The letters come into being with the essence itself, as one thing.

phrases.he: ונמצא על ידי האותיות יש בחינת השתלשלות עילה ועלול מעצם הנפש עד סוף מעשה,
phrases.en: So you see that the whole *hishtalshelus* from the *etzem hanefesh* to the *sof maaseh*

phrases.he: ושרש האותיות הוא בעצם הנפש ממש

blocks.text: So through the letters there is a *hishtalshelus* (chain of descent) of *ila v'alul* (cause and effect) from the essence of the soul to the end of action. In the *nimshal* (what the analogy stands for), the whole world comes from the letters in the *Atzmus*, passed down level after level: from the *ratzon hapashut* and *Ana Emloch* ("I shall rule") through the *reshimu* (the impression) and the *Kav* (the ray) to *Adam Kadmon* and *Atzilus*, on down to *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Asiya*, through the angelic ministers and the *mazalos* (constellations) and all that business, all the way down to here.

That is where all the snow outside came from, and the walls around you, the ground under your feet, the earth pulling you down so you do not fly off into the air: everything was passed down that way into a *metzius yesh* (an existing something). If there were no *metzius yesh* of letters upstairs, how could there be one down here? Upstairs is not abstract. The letters upstairs are bigger than the letters below: one letter, like the *yud* of the Name of the *hishtalshelus*, the *chachma* of *Atzilus*, includes all these worlds.
blocks.outOfPlace: Tape 209 opens by carrying on with line 43 where tape 208 stopped, before he rereads the line at 209 w1235.

blocks.title: Rich and poor
blocks.text: So it is a bigger existence, like the rich man, who also has $10. The *yud* upstairs includes all these things, and this whole world came out of there: will you say there is less existence up there? Just the opposite, there is more. That is why, when you go all the way back up, it is called the *yesh ha'amiti*: the real something, the absolute something.
blocks.outOfPlace: Tape 209 opens by carrying on with line 43 where tape 208 stopped, before he rereads the line at 209 w1235.

blocks.title: Nervous before a job interview
blocks.text: As the Rebbe says in the *Tanya*, the thought that comes out of an emotion is like nothing compared to the emotion. The nervous *hirhurim* are nothing next to the nervousness he feels; that is nothing next to his brain, with all the reasons; and that is nothing next to his will, where it is not just the job but his wife, the swimming pool, sending his kids to college. It gets bigger as you go up.
blocks.outOfPlace: Tape 209 opens by carrying on with line 43 where tape 208 stopped, before he rereads the line at 209 w1235.

blocks.title: Bill Gates and the tomatoes
blocks.text: Something abstract is not less than something concrete; you see it nowadays with software. All of Bill Gates's oodles of money came out of an abstraction. What abstraction did the tomatoes of a man who sells tomatoes come out of? A listener answers that every invention starts as an idea; but even once software is produced it is letters, not a physical thing like a tomato. Or a song: the Beatles made zillions out of songs, intellectual property. Software is more abstract than tomatoes, maybe more than a song, and he means the original idea, the spark, the flash of *chachma*: *hachachma techayeh ba'aleha*, wisdom gives life to its owners. All this money comes out of a *chachma*; you need a lot of tomatoes to make what one spark of *chachma* makes.
blocks.outOfPlace: Tape 209 opens by carrying on with line 43 where tape 208 stopped, before he rereads the line at 209 w1235.

blocks.title: Bill Gates and the tomatoes
blocks.text: People with twenty supermarkets still don't have money like Bill Gates or the Beatles, who had maybe a hundred songs, if that much. Elvis had maybe a hundred songs, has been dead for years, and they are still making money on it. A whole big store like the May Company, he thinks, does not have the kind of money the Beatles made from a few songs.
blocks.outOfPlace: Tape 209 opens by carrying on with line 43 where tape 208 stopped, before he rereads the line at 209 w1235.

blocks.title: Bill Gates and the tomatoes
blocks.text: And money is money, a solid thing. Yet even money is kept in abstract software bank accounts. Where is it? It is an idea. Even cash in your hand is not gold anymore; it is a piece of paper with an idea written on it. A man says he has $100 million in bank accounts: it is all electronics, theoretical numbers. In our days you can *mamash* see that something abstract is not less than something concrete.
blocks.outOfPlace: Tape 209 opens by carrying on with line 43 where tape 208 stopped, before he rereads the line at 209 w1235.

blocks.text: Just the opposite: the main thing about an abstract idea is how much money you can make with it. As the Frierdiker Rebbe (the previous Rebbe) said, you see how crass and coarse the Americans are from what they ask: "What's he worth?" Not that he is worth something because he is a *talmid chacham* (a Torah scholar), a *tzaddik*, a *parush* (an ascetic), but "he's worth $100 million". Yet even the $100 million is an abstraction.
blocks.outOfPlace: Tape 209 opens by carrying on with line 43 where tape 208 stopped, before he rereads the line at 209 w1235.

sensitivity.reason: Calls Americans crass and coarse, quoting a saying of the Frierdiker Rebbe.
sensitivity.publishable: Just the opposite: the main thing about an abstract idea is how much money you can make with it. As the Frierdiker Rebbe (the previous Rebbe) said, you see what people value from what they ask: "What's he worth?" Not that he is worth something because he is a *talmid chacham* (a Torah scholar), a *tzaddik*, a *parush* (an ascetic), but "he's worth $100 million". Yet even the $100 million is an abstraction.

blocks.text: It can be in buildings, but it doesn't have to be; it can be abstract property, and it is still a something. Someone like Bill Gates can buy physical buildings with it if he wants, and horses, whatever he wants. He can buy a lot of tomatoes with it.

blocks.text: So through the letters there is a chain of cause and effect from the essence of the soul to the end of action, and the root of the letters is in the essence of the soul *mamash*. Upstairs, in the *nimshal*, it is in the *Atzmus*.

phrases.he: ומכל זה יובן בשרש ומחצב האותיות בעצם הנפש,
שמתהווים עם עצם אור הנפש כאחד
phrases.en: is *mamash* one thing. It is *etzem or hanefesh*.

phrases.he: כמו שמתהווה בחי כח התנועה עמו כו'
phrases.en: When a *chai* is *mis'haveh*, the *koach hatnua*, it's not like a separate thing that is added on, it's *mis'haveh imo*.

phrases.he: וכהאי גוונא ודי למבין.

blocks.text: From all this one understands the root and source of the letters in the essence of the soul: they come into being together with the light of the soul's essence, and **is *mamash* one thing**. **It is *etzem or hanefesh*** (the essence of the light of the soul). As with the *koach hatnua* (power of movement) of a living thing: **it's not like a separate thing that is added on**; it comes into being with it. It is *mamash* one thing. It is not that the *Aibershter* is full of letters: it is the same thing.

phrases.he: והנמשל מכל זה הרי מובן
phrases.en: it's the letters of *kaviyachol*

phrases.he: ממילא, דאותיות שבטהירו עילאה שאמר גליף גליפו כו',
phrases.en: it's with letters, *glif glifu*

phrases.he: היינו בחינת אותיות העצמיים דמחשבה ודבור שבעצמות אור אין סוף
כמו על דרך משל אותיות הקבועים בעצם הנפש דיחידה כו'
בג' מדריגות הנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: in these three levels, to picture what you want, and the letters mixed up, and the letters fixed up according to what you want

phrases.he: ואותיות הללו משתלשלים ממהות למהות,
phrases.en: they go down from one *mahus* to another

phrases.he: כמו מרצון הפשוט שעלה במחשבה אנא אמלוך שלפני הצמצום, עד גם ברצון ושכל ומדות דאדם קדמון ועתיק יומין ואריך אנפין ואבא ואמא וזעיר אנפין ונוקבה דאצילות
הכל נמשך ויורד מזה לזה דרך עילה ועלול בשינוי מהות למהות על ידי בחינת האותיות של כל מהות שהוא בחינת גלוי היש שלו במציאת כנזכר לעיל
עד בחינת סוף מעשה דמלכות דאצילות, שהוא בחינת אותיות דמעשה דמלכות דאצילות, עד מלכות דמלכות דעשיה, שרש התהוות העולם השפל שלנו
(כמו שיתבאר בסוף הקונטרס)
phrases.en: like this will be explained later

phrases.he: שנכלל הכל במה שכתוב כל אשר חפץ יהו״ה בעצמותו ממש, עשה בפועל ממש, ודי למבין:

blocks.text: The *nimshal* follows by itself: **it's the letters of *kaviyachol*** (so to speak). The letters in the *tehiru ila'a* (the upper space), of which it says *glif glifu* (He engraved an engraving): **it's with letters, *glif glifu***. They are the essential letters of thought and speech in the *Atzmus Or Ein Sof*, like the letters fixed in the essence of the soul, the *yechida*, **in these three levels, to picture what you want, and the letters mixed up, and the letters fixed up according to what you want**.

And these letters **go down from one *mahus* to another**: from the *ratzon hapashut* that arose in thought, *Ana Emloch*, before the *tzimtzum*, to the will, intellect and emotions of *Adam Kadmon*, *Atik*, *Arich Anpin*, *Abba* and *Ima*, and *Zeir Anpin* and *Nukva* of *Atzilus*. It all comes down by cause and effect, from *mahus* to *mahus*, through the letters of each, down to the end of action of *Malchus* of *Atzilus*, and to *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Asiya*, the root of our world, **like this will be explained later**. All of it is included in the verse: whatever G-d desired, in His very Essence, He did in actual deed.

reviewQuestions.question: What are the three levels of the letters of thought, and the three of the letters of speech? Which of them does an animal have?
Why does he say the letters of speech are higher than the letters of thought, and what follows for Torah study?
Why are the letters not the *koach hagvul*, and what does the rich man with $10 show about the infinite?
Without letters, why could the hidden will not pass into the reason for the will, or into the love in the will?
How does the man waiting for a job interview show letters going from intellect to emotion and from emotion to thought?
Why is there more existence up above than down here, not less?

Line 52: after "עשה בפועל ממש" he reads on "למטה הנה הועמדנו" (209 w1522-1524), which is not in the chapter file or the first line of chapter 39; it may be his edition's wording. He does not translate line 52; the block gives the verse in English as the line quotes it.
